title: Source-bound scheduled irrigation inventory and smallest hydraulic-view seam

outer_requirements: no fixed irrigation event already selected
legacy_scheduled_gate.event_ordering: fixed event selection precedes scheduled selection; scheduled irrigation is considered only when no fixed event has already been selected

TCS1.rule: interpolate allowable actual/potential transpiration ratio from treltab at DVS; trigger when 1-(iqreddry_day+iqredsol_day)/iptra_day is below threshold

TCS2.rule: trigger from depletion of readily available root-zone water

TCS3.rule: trigger from depletion of totally available root-zone water

TCS4.rule: trigger when root-zone depletion exceeds DVS-dependent allowed amount

TCS6.rule: increment dayfix once per legacy Irrigation(3) daily call; every seventh count test root-zone deficit against irgthreshold

TCS7.rule: phcrit = afgen(hcritab,14,DVS); trigger when h(sensor_node) <= phcrit

TCS8.rule: thetacrit = afgen(tcritab,14,DVS); trigger when theta(sensor_node) <= thetacrit

legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.finding: B1.10 performs root-zone capacity, deficit and watcon calculations before every tcs>1 branch, including TCS7, although TCS7+DCS2 does not consume those calculated values.
legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.target_action: do not copy this broad legacy prelude into the restricted TCS7+DCS2 seam
legacy_tcs_gt_1_prelude.scientific_caveat: watcon and related legacy routines can touch global/model context, so removal of incidental side effects is not declared scientifically equivalent by F-PM04; later independent F-VQ must test observable full-runtime behavior

minimum_interval_overlay.tcsfix: if enabled, event is admitted only when dayfix >= irgdayfix; accepted event resets dayfix to 1, otherwise dayfix increments while below interval
minimum_interval_overlay.legacy_time_semantics: one increment per Irrigation(3) call, which is invoked at flDayStart; therefore this is day-count management semantics, not a generic elapsed-time counter

DCS1.rule: irr_depth=max(0,cdef + afgen(ditab,DVS)*0.1 - grai_red), with grai_red=grai when grai>raithreshold

DCS2.target_translation: adapter converts immutable FID table values from legacy mm to cm before process evaluation

afgen_table_semantics.legacy_layout: alternating x,y values in a 14-element array
legacy_behavior: x <= first knot returns first y
interior values use piecewise linear interpolation
decreasing next x acts as partial-table sentinel and returns previous y
fully populated table clamps values above the final knot to final y
afgen_table_semantics.source_read_behavior: RDADOR/RDDATA may fill fewer than seven x,y pairs and does not define unused caller-array tail elements
selected_target_contract: for partial tables fail closed if runtime DVS exceeds the final supplied knot
do not preserve or depend on stale SAVE-array tail state

rate_and_application_rules.normal_positive_rate: if irr_rate>0 and irr_depth/irr_rate<=1: surface gird=irr_rate or SSDI qssdi(node range)=irr_rate; dt_irr_event=irr_depth/irr_rate
rate_and_application_rules.positive_rate_too_slow: if irr_depth/irr_rate>1: temporarily adapt applied rate to irr_depth and use dt_irr_event=1 day
rate_and_application_rules.zero_rate: spread irr_depth evenly over the whole day and use dt_irr_event=1 day
rate_and_application_rules.task4_external_scaling: legacy MultiSWAP may later scale gird and event duration by f_irr_avail; excluded from smallest seam

scheduled_ssdi_source_semantics.multi_node_finding: scheduled DCS2 depth is not divided by selected SSDI node count before assigning the same source rate to every node
scheduled_ssdi_source_semantics.fixed_event_contrast: fixed-event SSDI divides fixed-event depth by node count before execution

calendar_and_management.start_end_window: annual startirr/endirr with cross-year crop handling in legacy initialization/runtime
calendar_and_management.smallest_seam_contract: calendar-window membership and crop-emergence are explicit management inputs to the process-facing request; hidden midnight or one-day kernel assumptions are prohibited

selected_smallest_seam.name: TCS7_DCS2_SINGLE_NODE_SSDI_REGULAR_RATE
selected_smallest_seam.why: TCS7 consumes one committed pressure-head sample through the qualified process hydraulic view; DCS2 needs only DVS and an immutable translated depth table; single-node SSDI reuses the existing admitted node-source and mass route while avoiding both unadmitted surface gird-to-nird composition and unresolved scheduled multi-node mass semantics.
included: outer explicit management gates: irrigation enabled, schedule enabled, crop emerged, irrigation window open, no fixed event already selected
DCS2 DVS-dependent fixed irrigation depth in cm after adapter translation
SSDI application at exactly one pretranslated immutable node
explicit node source and reconciliation external inflow result
excluded: legacy broad root-zone depletion and watcon prelude
surface scheduled application and gird-to-nird composition

immutable_parameters: DCS2 explicit-knot DVS/depth table in cm
persistent_process_state: only active scheduled-event continuation/timing when an event spans multiple solver intervals

mass_ownership.authoritative_runtime_accounting: accepted F-KT/F-MR accounting through the already-qualified SSDI source route
mass_ownership.existing_scientific_evidence: F-VQ18 independently verified the existing positive SSDI source route through real F-MR/F-KT with authoritative total_in exactly once; it does not admit scheduled TCS/DCS equations
